Details.title: Details
Details.description: The full money-movement payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this: {"title":"Send money","fromAccount":{"label":"Everyday Checking","mask":"1234"},"recipients":[{"id":"rcp-1","name":"Alex Rivera","type":"person","mask":"4821","detail":"Checking"},{"id":"rcp-2","name":"Rewards Card","type":"card","mask":"9012","detail":"Credit Card"},{"id":"rcp-3","name":"High-Yield Savings","type":"account","mask":"5678","detail":"Savings"}],"amountPresets":[{"id":"amt-1","label":"$50","amount":50},{"id":"amt-2","label":"$100","amount":100},{"id":"amt-3","label":"$250","amount":250},{"id":"amt-4","label":"Minimum","amount":35}],"currency":"USD","allowOther":true,"otherText":"Other amount","submitText":"Continue"} Rules: - 'title' (string, optional): the heading shown above the card. - 'fromAccount' (object, optional): the account the money comes FROM. Has 'label' (string, e.g. 'Everyday Checking') and optional 'mask' (string, last 4 digits). Shown as 'From Everyday Checking ••1234'. - 'recipients' (array, REQUIRED, at least one object): who the money can go TO. Each MUST have 'id' (string, unique, sent back on selection) and 'name' (string). Optional per recipient: 'type' (string; one of 'person','card','account','business','external' — drives the row icon; 'account' means one of the customer's own accounts), 'mask' (string, last 4 digits), 'detail' (string, a short descriptor like 'Checking' or 'Credit Card'). - 'amountPresets' (array, optional but recommended): tappable amounts. Each has 'id' (string, unique), 'amount' (number), and optional 'label' (string; if omitted the amount is formatted as currency). Use contextual presets when relevant, e.g. {"id":"amt-min","label":"Minimum","amount":35} or {"id":"amt-stmt","label":"Statement balance","amount":742.18}. - 'currency' (string, optional): ISO code used to format amounts; defaults to 'USD'. - 'allowOther' (boolean, optional): set true to show an 'Other amount' chip that hands the custom amount back to the conversation. - 'otherText' (string, optional): the 'Other amount' chip label; defaults to 'Other amount'. - 'submitText' (string, optional): the confirm-button label; defaults to 'Continue'. Never emit an empty 'recipients' array. Use the customer's real payees/accounts from context; if none are known, ask the customer rather than inventing recipients. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
